# hetznerrobot_storagebox_subaccount (Resource)

A sub-account of a Storage Box — an extra login confined to one directory. Only the inclusive **BX10 (100 GB)** Storage Box of a dedicated server is still managed through Robot; every other Storage Box moved to the [Hetzner Console API](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/hetzner#storage-boxes) (the `hcloud` provider). Every Storage Box write is limited to one request per 5 seconds, which the provider waits out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Robot generates the password when none is set; read it from the sensitive
# `password` attribute.
resource "hetznerrobot_storagebox_subaccount" "db" {
  storagebox_id  = hetznerrobot_storagebox.backup.id
  home_directory = "backups/db"
  ssh            = true
  readonly       = false
  comment        = "database dumps"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `home_directory` (String) Home directory of the sub-account, relative to the box's root.
- `storagebox_id` (Number) Storage Box the sub-account belongs to.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment on the sub-account.
- `external_reachability` (Boolean) Whether the sub-account is reachable from outside the Hetzner network.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the sub-account. Left out, Robot generates one on create and it is kept here; set, it is applied whenever it changes. Robot never returns it, so after an import it is null until set. 12–128 characters with upper and lower case letters, a digit and a special character.
- `readonly` (Boolean) Whether the sub-account can only read.
- `samba` (Boolean) Whether Samba (SMB/CIFS) access is enabled.
- `ssh` (Boolean) Whether SSH access is enabled.
- `webdav` (Boolean) Whether WebDAV access is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) User name of the box's main user.
- `create_time` (String) Creation time.
- `server` (String) Host name to connect to.
- `username` (String) User name Robot assigns, e.g. `u12345-sub1`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_storagebox_subaccount.db 123456/u12345-sub1
```
